review.name: Storm Roc
findings: Fresh first pass actually inspected: all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices across all thirteen clips and all 216 actual equipped-technique frames. Beak and forehead keep their shape, crest follows the skull, scarf meets the neck continuously, and wings, body, feet and tail remain connected. Independent frozen face probes pass 468 blends per asset; full-geometry probes report zero warnings at 203 poses per asset. No source or battle-model change required. Final runtime and repeat visual review pending.

Second pass actually inspected and passed all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, all 32 runtime transition slices at low/medium, 216 native equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless strips, 24 advancing companion idle frames and sixteen atlas cells. Source and battle model bytes unchanged. Defeat face partly hidden by the near wing in side views; exposed front views used for face inspection, side views for wing/body continuity. Whole-roster/main/live verification remains pending.
